label: Ancien Régime Social and Institutional Order
description: Understanding the corporate structure, divine-right monarchy, and institutional gridlock of 18th-century France.

label: The Three Estates and Fiscal Privileges
description: Analyzing the legal divisions between First (Clergy), Second (Nobility), and Third (Commoners/Bourgeoisie) estates and tax exemptions.

label: Crown Debt and Structural Fiscal Impasse
description: Tracing the sovereign debt crisis from the Seven Years' War and American Revolution, compounding interest, and royal borrowing limits.

label: Enlightenment Philosophy and Popular Sovereignty
description: Understanding how Enlightenment concepts of natural rights, social contracts, and popular sovereignty challenged divine right.

label: Convocation and Voting Crisis of the Estates-General
description: Analyzing the electoral process, Cahiers de Doléances, and procedural standoff over voting by order versus voting by head.

label: The National Assembly and Tennis Court Oath
description: Examining the self-proclamation of the Third Estate as the National Assembly and the pledge to establish a constitutional monarchy.

label: Storming of the Bastille and Popular Mobilization
description: Evaluating the tactical panic, gunpowder search, seizure of the fortress, and political intervention of the Parisian urban crowd.

label: Declaration of the Rights of Man and of the Citizen
description: Analyzing the foundational tenets of civic equality, liberty, property, legal limits, and initial exclusions of women and colonial subjects.

label: Chronological Reasoning and Periodization
description: Placing events in chronological order and recognizing immediate antecedents vs. broader epochs.

label: Multi-Causal Historical Analysis
description: Distinguishing between structural preconditions, medium-term catalysts, and immediate short-term triggers.

label: Primary Source Interrogation and Provenance
description: Evaluating provenance, audience, purpose, and credibility of historical documents and material evidence.

label: Historiographical Perspective and Contextualization
description: Identifying authorial bias, contemporary ideological frameworks, and avoiding anachronistic moralizing.

label: Evidence-Backed Historical Argumentation
description: Constructing coherent historiographical claims supported by corroborated primary and secondary sources.

label: Literal and Inferential Reading Comprehension
description: Extracting explicit information and decoding implied authorial tone and subtext.

label: Argument Identification and Claim Parsing
description: Distinguishing central claims, supporting premises, factual assertions, and opinions.

label: Source Credibility and Evidence Evaluation
description: Assessing the sufficiency, relevance, and representative strength of evidence used to support arguments.

label: Thesis Formulation and Reasoning Construction
description: Drafting precise, contestable analytical thesis statements backed by warrants and textual justification.

label: Structured Analytical Essay Composition
description: Organizing sustained analytical writing with clear transitions, unified paragraphs, and evidence integration.

label: Rhetorical Strategies and Persuasion Analysis
description: Evaluating ethos, pathos, logos, syntax, and rhetorical figures in persuasive discourse.
